# Orange Coast College

> > Orange Coast College (OCC) is a California community college offering transfer programs to UC/CSU systems, career certificates in technology and business, and comprehensive student services.

Orange Coast College is the #1 transfer college in Orange County to institutions like UC Irvine, UCLA, and UC Santa Barbara. Part of the Coast Community College District, OCC provides associate degrees, certificate programs in fields like computer science (C++, Java, Python), hospitality, and athletic training, along with ESL and transfer preparation services.

## Key Topics

- Transfer programs to UC and CSU systems
- Certificate programs and associate degrees
- Computer science (C++, Java, Python)
- California residency and tuition classification
- MyCoast student portal
- Coast Community College District
- Financial aid and cost of attendance
- Athletic training and kinesiology
- Hospitality and culinary arts
- ESL and language programs
- Program review and accreditation (ACCJC)
- Student enrollment and registration
- Business and management certificates
- Academic Senate governance

## Admissions & Enrollment

- [#1 Transfer College in OC](https://orangecoastcollege.edu/s/top-transfer/index.html): #1 OC transfer college to UC Irvine, UCLA, UC Santa Barbara
- [Graduation](https://orangecoastcollege.edu/admissions-aid/enrollment/graduation.html): Degree petition process, ADT requirements, and graduation deadlines
- [Cost of Attendance](https://orangecoastcollege.edu/admissions-aid/financial-aid/cost-of-attendance.html): Tuition, fees, and financial aid budget for OCC vs UC/CSU systems
- [California Residency Information](https://orangecoastcollege.edu/admissions-aid/enrollment/admissions/residency.html): CA residency requirements and tuition classification under Title 5
- [Closed Classes & Add Permits](https://orangecoastcollege.edu/admissions-aid/enrollment/registration/closed-classes.html): Waitlist procedures, add permits, and add codes via MyCoast Portal
- [Holds Information](https://orangecoastcollege.edu/admissions-aid/enrollment/registration/holds.html): Registration holds, fee payment methods, and MyCoast account info

## Academic Programs & Certificates

- [Business-Business Division Program Certificates](https://orangecoastcollege.edu/academics/business-computing/business/program-certificates.html): Business and computer science certificate programs with C++ and Java
- [Management - Business Division Program Certificates](https://orangecoastcollege.edu/academics/business-computing/management/program-certificates.html): Management and entrepreneurship certificate specialization programs
- [Technology Division](https://orangecoastcollege.edu/academics/technology/index.html): Technology career training, certificates, and UC/CSU transfer courses
- [Hospitality Programs](https://orangecoastcollege.edu/academics/consumer-health/hospitality/index.html): Culinary arts, baking, food service, and travel tourism programs
- [Athletic Training Level 1](https://orangecoastcollege.edu/academics/kinesiology-athletics/degrees-certificates/athletic-training.html): CAATE-aligned Athletic Training Level 1 certificate program details
- [Guided Self Placement - ESL](https://orangecoastcollege.edu/academics/lit-lang/esl/guided-self-placement.html): ESL guided self-placement tool for course level selection
